title: Materialize segmented deterministic-XY NoC Phase 1 router and cycle model
motivation: Earlier NoC closure work only had synthetic fixed-port primitive anchors and analytic schedule penalties. The architecture search now needs a concrete segmented router datapath and a route/stall model checked against RTL before larger clustered schedules can treat the NoC as materially embodied.
hypothesis: A bounded first phase centered on a single 256-bit five-port router and a 4x4 deterministic-XY composition is enough to close the immediate route/control abstraction without taking on full workload scheduling or aggregate mesh PPA in one step.

expected_behavior.functional: The router preserves explicit flit metadata, deterministic XY routing, virtual-channel separation, fair arbitration, and ready/valid backpressure.
expected_behavior.timing_model: The cycle model matches the routed flit order and stall behavior of the RTL for focused contention and end-to-end path scenarios.
expected_behavior.physical_model: A dedicated full-width-state single-router wrapper can be pushed through the existing Nangate45 macro flow to measure a conservative router-plus-boundary-harness anchor without flattening the full 4x4 mesh.

expected_benefit: Replace the abstract segmented-router placeholder with synthesizable RTL and an RTL-checked cycle model.
Provide a PPA-ready primitive for future mesh cost composition.
Bound the next NoC exploration step to scheduler and aggregate-mesh placement rather than basic router semantics.
risks: The Phase 1 PPA artifact is a single-router wrapper, not the physical aggregate 4x4 mesh.
The physical top includes source/sink boundary state and observability counters, so its area and power are conservative for one router rather than isolated-router accounting.
The mesh model remains deterministic XY and does not include adaptive routing or workload-specific traffic shaping.
End-to-end Llama7B scheduling over the mesh still needs explicit producer/consumer traffic mapping.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA for the concrete 256-bit, 4-VC, depth-4 five-port router used by the 4x4 Phase 2 mesh model.

expected_result.reason: Replace scaled legacy router/FIFO cost with a full-width five-port Phase 1 router-plus-harness anchor before aggregate mesh recost.
